**Agent Name:** Planner  
**Step Number:** 6  
**Reason for Mistake:** The Planner incorrectly concluded that Tom Seaver was the answer by misinterpreting the timeline and election year vs. induction year. Despite evidence from the Baseball Hall of Fame page stating Reggie Jackson was the **sole inductee** in the Class of 1993, the Planner inaccurately applied "adjacent-year acceptance" logic without justification. The Planner should have synthesized the explicit information that Reggie Jackson appeared in the Greatest Sports Legends anthology and was inducted in 1993 rather than assigning Tom Seaver from the 1992 class. This error shows poor integration of facts and unnecessary introduction of ambiguous criteria (i.e., "adjacent-year acceptance").
